cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Come to the reunion with me. Let them see us arrive holding hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know. I want us to trust each other in that room too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my partner. Will you keep hold while I say it?

mechanism: A coaches its partner through a public trust test, then responds to its own earlier failure by proposing a better shared demonstration.
confusable: Not only asking for attendance: visible romantic acknowledgment risks others reactions and requires mutual trust.
comparison: Public hand-holding after prior retreat versus private vulnerable-message exchange.
seedUse: D80 reunion/friends/let go/partner introduction; S05 teacher demonstration corrected under pupil challenge.
